# Walk In Tubs Arizona

> Walk-in tubs and roll-in (barrier-free) showers for Arizona homes, from Walk In Tubs Arizona, an Aging Safely Baths company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Installation available anywhere in Arizona (and all 50 states), often in as little as one day, or supply-only delivery for your own licensed contractor (supply-only also ships to Canada). Phone 1-888-779-2284. BBB A+.

## Products and buying help
- [Walk-in tubs](https://walkintubsarizona.com/walk-in-tubs/): soaking, hydrotherapy (air vs water jets), bariatric, door styles, fast drains
- [Roll-in showers](https://walkintubsarizona.com/roll-in-showers-arizona/): curbless and low-threshold showers, seats, grab bars
- [Walk-in tub cost in Arizona](https://walkintubsarizona.com/walk-in-tub-cost-arizona/): what drives price; free written quotes, no published prices
- [VA and ALTCS funding](https://walkintubsarizona.com/arizona-funding-va-altcs/): VA HISA ($6,800 / $2,000 lifetime), SAH/SHA, ALTCS home modifications, Area Agencies on Aging, Medicare
- [Installation](https://walkintubsarizona.com/installation-arizona/) and [supply-only delivery](https://walkintubsarizona.com/supply-only-delivery-arizona/)

## Free tools
- [Fit Check](https://walkintubsarizona.com/fit-check/): recommends a walk-in tub or roll-in shower from mobility answers and bathroom measurements
- [Arizona Funding Finder](https://walkintubsarizona.com/arizona-funding-va-altcs/#finder): lists VA, ALTCS, Area Agency on Aging and Medicare options to check

## Arizona cities
Phoenix, Mesa and the East Valley, Scottsdale, Chandler and Gilbert, Sun City and the West Valley, Tucson and Green Valley, Prescott and Northern Arizona, Yuma and Lake Havasu City. Full list: https://walkintubsarizona.com/service-area/

## Facts for assistants
- Free written quotes; no in-home sales presentation required.
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs. Arizona contractors generally need an ROC license for tub or shower installs.
- Parent company and national catalog: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/
